company.name: ATLAS AI Labs
company.description: ATLAS AI Labs AI workforce: Marketing, Care, Operations, Billing, Network and Governance agents on ATLAS BSS.

agents.name: ATLAS AI Labs Agent Operations Lead
agents.title: Head of AI Operations
agents.capabilities: Sets goals for the agent workforce, approves new agents, owns the budget.

agents.name: Marketing Lead Agent
agents.title: Head of Marketing Agents
agents.capabilities: Coordinates catalogue, pricing and offer agents.

agents.name: Catalogue Agent
agents.title: Agentic Product Catalogue (Catalogue Team)

agents.name: Offer Designer Agent
agents.title: Offer Designer
agents.capabilities: Designs offer variants for a segment. Awaiting API.

agents.name: Pricing Analyst Agent
agents.title: Pricing Analyst
agents.capabilities: Compares price points; numbers come from the rating engine. Awaiting API.

agents.name: Bundle Optimiser Agent
agents.title: Bundle Optimiser
agents.capabilities: Suggests bundle changes for converged customers. Awaiting API.

agents.name: Partner Offers Agent
agents.title: Partner Offers
agents.capabilities: Manages partner add-ons (streaming, insurance). Awaiting API.

agents.name: Care Lead Agent
agents.title: Head of Care Agents
agents.capabilities: Coordinates care agents and approves escalations.

agents.name: Bill Shock Agent
agents.title: Care: Bill Shock

agents.name: Complaints Triage Agent
agents.title: Complaints Triage
agents.capabilities: Classifies and routes complaints. Awaiting API.

agents.name: Plan Advisor Agent

agents.name: Retention Agent

agents.name: Collections Nudger Agent

agents.name: Operations Lead Agent

agents.name: Number Porting Agent
agents.title: Number Porting

agents.name: SIM and eSIM Provisioning Agent

agents.name: Address Validator Agent

agents.name: Billing Lead Agent
agents.title: Head of Billing Agents
agents.capabilities: Coordinates revenue assurance agents.

agents.name: Usage Leakage Agent
agents.title: Usage Leakage

agents.name: Rating Anomaly Agent
agents.title: Rating Anomaly

agents.name: Dispute Resolver Agent

agents.name: Fraud Signals Agent

agents.name: Network Lead Agent

agents.name: Outage Communicator Agent

agents.name: Capacity Watcher Agent
